summary: Duplicate invoice line items after customer org merge leading to overstated monthly bill
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that their February invoice contains duplicate line items for embedding meters after they merged two organization accounts into a single dedicated billing account. The invoice total is ~18% higher than expected.

Impact:
BrightDoc.ai reports potential overcharge of $12,450 for Feb invoice. This is a revenue-impacting claim and blocks finance reconciliation for the customer. Customer cannot approve payment until clarified.

Environment:
- Dedicated tenant: brightdoc-dedicated-01
- Region: us-east-1 (primary)
- Metering pipeline: billing-ingest-v2 (Kinesis -> billing-service)

Steps to reproduce (customer-facing):
1. Merge org A (brightdoc-labs) into org B (brightdoc) via Console > Account > Migrate Orgs on 2026-02-20.
2. Run normal batch embedding workloads from both prior orgs in late Feb (concurrent streaming and batch jobs).
3. Download invoice for Feb 2026 from Console -> Billing -> Invoices.

Observed behavior:
- Invoice shows two separate line items labeled "embedding_units" with identical pricing tiers for overlapping date ranges (2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28).
- Metering totals in Console -> Usage show a single aggregated usage number that matches expected value, but the invoice line items sum to ~118% of that amount.

Expected behavior:
- Single aggregated invoice line for embedding usage for the merged org, with credits and plan discounts applied once.

Attachments / logs provided by customer:
- Customer exported CSV of usage and the invoice PDF (attached to ticket).
- Screenshot of Console usage page showing single total.

Notes: customer has an active dedicated reservation and a monthly embed credit that should have been applied post-merge.
comments: 2026-03-09 Maya Chen: Filed per customer call at 16:40 PST. Customer provided invoice PDF and usage CSV. Asking for an itemized explanation of the two embedding line items.
2026-03-09 Support Triage: Assigned to billing team for investigation. Raising priority due to finance hold. Tentative SLA breach window: 2026-03-11.

2026-03-10 Liam O'Connell: Initial triage - ingestion logs show two distinct meter-source IDs for embedding events coming from legacy org_id (brightdoc-labs) and new org_id (brightdoc). Suspect merge did not update historical meter metadata for events in the billing window.

2026-03-10 SRE (Priya Rao): Verified Kinesis shards received duplicate records from the org-merge job replay on 2026-02-22. One stream contained re-ingested historical events and the other contained live events; deduplication filter did not match because org_id tag changed during merge.

2026-03-11 Liam O'Connell: Worked with Billing Service owner to query billing_events table. Found ~42k embedding events duplicated between meter_source=legacy-merge-replay and meter_source=live-ingest. Drafting a reconciliation query to collapse duplicates and recalc invoice lines.
2026-03-12 Finance (Aneesh Patel): Customer requests a provisional credit while backend reconciliation completes. Asked for estimated credit amount and ETA for corrected invoice.
2026-03-12 Liam O'Connell: Proposed provisional credit of $12,450 (matches customer's overage claim) subject to reconciliation. Seeking approvals from Revenue Ops and Billing PM.
2026-03-12 Revenue Ops (Elena Garcia): Approved provisional credit. Requested formal audit trail for the adjustment and a postmortem once fixed.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 - Query run against billing_events: SELECT count(*) FROM billing_events WHERE customer_id='brightdoc' AND event_time BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-02-28' AND event_type='embedding' GROUP BY meter_source; result: live-ingest: 358,912 events; legacy-merge-replay: 42,176 events.

Duplicates arise when the org-merge replay job re-ingested historical events without preserving original external_event_id; dedup key is (external_event_id, org_id) so org_id change prevented deduping.
Billing pipeline dedupe config (billing-ingest-v2) has a 48-hour window for deduplication using event_id; the replay occurred outside that window and used a new meter_source tag.

Customer credits policy: monthly embed credits applied at invoice-generation time; reconciliation script reads aggregated usage by customer_id, not by meter_source, but invoice generation step iterates line groups and a bug caused it to create per-meter_source lines when multiple meter_sources exist for the same customer in the period.
Replication: Replayed merge in staging and reproduced duplicate invoice line creation when billing_events table contains >1 meter_source for same customer in invoice period.
Hypothesis: Two contributing bugs - (1) org-merge replay re-ingests historical events and (2) invoice-generation logic groups by meter_source when building line items if meter_source count >1.
resolution:
In progress - workaround applied and corrective action planned:
1) Provisional credit: Revenue Ops approved a provisional credit of $12,450 issued to BrightDoc.ai on 2026-03-12 to unblock payment. Credit ID: CR-2026-0332. (Provisionals must be reconciled post-audit.)
2) Hotfix: Billing Service PR (#819) will change invoice-generation to aggregate usage by customer_id before splitting line items. PR merged to hotfix branch; rollout to staging verified on 2026-03-12.
3) Data cleanup: Run reconciliation script to dedupe billing_events for affected period and regenerate invoice lines, then issue corrected invoice. Reconciliation job scheduled 2026-03-13 03:00 UTC; expected completion by 2026-03-13 06:00 UTC.
4) Postmortem and follow-up: Postmortem doc requested, and engineering to add dedupe-by-original-event-id support in org-merge replay tool to avoid future re-ingests creating new external_event_ids.

Next steps:
- Confirm reconciliation job completed successfully and attach run logs. (Owner: Liam O'Connell)
- Generate corrected invoice and notify customer with explanation and audit trail. (Owner: Billing PM - Nora Kim)
- Close provisional credit against final invoice once audit completes. (Owner: Finance)

Current status: provisional credit issued, hotfix staged, data reconciliation scheduled. Awaiting reconciliation completion and final invoice generation.
public_resolution_note: We identified duplicate invoice line items tied to an org-merge replay that re-ingested historical metering events. A provisional credit has been issued and we will send a corrected invoice after internal reconciliation. We apologize for the disruption and will share the postmortem when complete.
customer_communication_status: Customer notified of provisional credit and planned timeline; awaiting their confirmation after corrected invoice is sent.
notes: Please coordinate with Revenue Ops for final credit accounting entries.
Billing PM to prepare a short FAQ for customers undergoing org merges explaining expected behavior and controls.
SRE to add an alert if billing_events contains more than one meter_source for same customer in invoice window to catch regressions.
Follow-up ticket: INT-981: Add original_event_id preservation to org-merge tool.
